**About the Role**  
  
The UberEats Feed Ranking team is responsible for the ML ranking layer which personalizes the Eats Homefeed. This personalization layer is one of the main drivers of order growth across the Delivery organization. As a Machine Learning Engineer (MLE) on the Feed Ranking team, you will own and develop models across our entire ranking stack (Retrieval + Pre-Ranking, Second Pass Ranking, Post-Ranking). Our models are sophisticated (>5B parameters), our features are rich (near-realtime engagement history with 1-year lookback), and our serving requirements are stringent (>10M QPS with low latency and high availability). As an MLE, the reward for working within these requirements is significant - offline performance gains in our ranking models are strongly correlated with topline impact for the entire Eats business.  
  
**What You’ll Do**  

* Own and develop on all parts of the ML lifecycle - both offline (training, model architecture, etc.) and online (serving efficiency, GPU provisioning + utilization, etc.).
* Bring SOTA ML techniques from DLRM and LLM literature (Scaling Laws, Kernel Fusion, Latent Attention, Agentic Auto-Research, RL-based post-ranking, etc.) into our modeling stack.
* Collaborate closely with backend engineers to ensure high-quality and reliability in end-to-end integration.
* Coordinate with Science and Product partners to maximize the business impact of ML improvements.

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics or related field, with 3+ years of full-time experience working on production ML systems.
* Strong proficiency in at least one programming language such as Python, Go, or Java.
* Strong proficiency with common Deep-Learning frameworks (PyTorch, Tensorflow/Keras, Jax, etc.).
* Experience with distributed data processing and ETL frameworks (Spark, Ray Data, etc.).
* Strong technical communication and ability to manage multiple cross functional stakeholders.

  
**Preferred Qualifications**  

* Master's or PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics or related field, with publications in the ML/AI space (papers, conference presentations, company technical blogs, etc.).
* Industry experience working on Deep Learning Recommendation Systems and/or LLM model development at scale in a production/user-facing environment.
* Experience optimizing Deep Learning model architectures + serving stack to improve GPU MFU across different hardware types.
* Desire to grow into technical leadership and become a force multiplier for junior engineers.

jobs.title: Computer Vision & Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description:
**What to Expect**

Own the path from line images to a solution Tesla can trust. We collect images on PCBA and TLA lines and developing models that to do this. Your job is to determine what the images can support, prove or kill an approach on our data, and leave us with a solution that works in production, whether that is a model we run, a system we buy, or a clear stop.

You will work with Supplier industrialization engineers, and internal Tesla stakeholders, external solution providers. You will be expected to identify a solution; you will not be handed a labeled dataset or a chosen architecture.

  
**What You'll Do**

* Assess line images for camera, lighting, resolution, and consistency across lines and products, and determine whether defects are visible and separable from normal variation
* Turn the quality problem into a testable vision problem, including which defect is in scope, the acceptable miss rate and false-reject rate, and the cycle time the result must meet
* Build the minimum dataset and labeling approach for rare defects, weak labels, and a large volume of good images
* Select classification, detection, segmentation, or anomaly detection based on the data, not a predetermined architecture
* Run a time-boxed proof on our images, comparing a small set of real options, including classical vision, a trained model, and a commercial AOI or vision system
* Recommend build versus buy, including what data, lighting, or camera changes are required before scaling
* Pilot the chosen approach on one line, covering latency, station integration, traceability, and monitoring
* Validate the chosen system on production data, covering holdout images, line trials, golden-sample checks, and other vision-system validation methods as the case requires
* Define the retraining path for product or process changes
* Report negative results with evidence when the images or the line cannot support the decision

  
**What You'll Bring**

* Several years shipping computer vision into a real operation, not only notebooks and benchmarks
* Factory, AOI, electronics, or other industrial inspection experience
* Experience in PCBA and electronic assembly manufacturing, including IPC workmanship and inspection standards
* Hands-on experience in detection, segmentation, classification, or visual anomaly detection, including labeling, class imbalance, domain shift, and threshold setting
* Ability to evaluate a model on escape rate, false rejects, and cycle time, not only accuracy or mAP
* Judgment to recommend a commercial system when it is the better path, and to distinguish a vendor demo from a result on our images
* Ability to work with design engineer, process and quality engineers and turn their defect definitions into a testable problem
* Proficiency in Python and a standard training stack
* Experience deploying a model to a station, edge device, or factory server
* Evidence of stopping an approach because the images or the operation could not support it

#### **Benefits**

Along with competitive pay, as a full-time Tesla employee, you are eligible for the following benefits at day 1 of hire:

* Medical plans > plan options with $0 payroll deduction
* Family-building, fertility, adoption and surrogacy benefits
* Dental (including orthodontic coverage) and vision plans, both have options with a $0 paycheck contribution
* Company Paid (Health Savings Accounts) HSA Contribution when enrolled in the High-Deductible medical plan with HSA
* Healthcare and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
* 401(k) with employer match, Employee Stock Purchase Plans, and other financial benefits
* Company paid Basic Life, AD&D
* Short-term and long-term disability insurance (90 day waiting period)
* Employee Assistance Program
* Sick and Vacation time (Flex time for salary positions, Accrued hours for Hourly positions), and Paid Holidays
* Back-up childcare and parenting support resources
* Voluntary benefits to include: critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident insurance, theft & legal services, and pet insurance
* Weight Loss and Tobacco Cessation Programs
* Tesla Babies program
* Commuter benefits
* Employee discounts and perks program
* Earned Wage Access: Real-time pay access paid daily, subject to eligibility and schedule (applicable for below Sr. Managers levels)

  

#### **Expected Compensation**

$100,000 - $372,000/annual salary + cash and stock awards + benefits

Mecka AI is building the data infrastructure layer for robotics and embodied AI.  
We design and operate global systems for data capture, data labeling, and hardware-enabled workflows used by leading AI labs and robotics companies to train and validate humanoid and embodied AI systems.  
We work closely with frontier robotics teams to bridge real-world data, simulation, learning-based systems, and deployed hardware.

**The role**

Our operators control robots across countries and oceans. You'll own the link between them: getting multiple camera streams to the operator and commands back to the robot with as little delay and jitter as physics allows, and building the interface operators use all day. Because every byte you stream is also training data, you'll own recording it on-site and getting it reliably off-site too.

**What you'll do**

* Build the real-time transport between robot sites and operator stations: low-latency video (multiple cameras, possibly depth), robot state, and control commands over the public internet.
* Own the end-to-end latency budget. Instrument glass-to-glass and command-to-motion latency, find where every millisecond goes, and cut it: encoding settings, transport choice, routing, jitter buffers, relay placement.
* Make the link robust: NAT traversal, congestion and packet loss, bandwidth adaptation, reconnection, and clear signals to the operator and robot when quality degrades.
* Design and build the operator interface: camera layouts, robot state and health, task instructions, latency and connection indicators, and fast workflows for starting, labeling, and ending episodes.
* Build operator-facing tooling: queueing operators to robots across sites, session handoff, and basic fleet visibility.
* Own on-site recording: capture synchronized streams and metadata into a well-defined episode format, buffer locally, and upload reliably over constrained site networks.
* Set up the infrastructure for data storage and access of robot teleop episodes.

### **About Mecka AI**

Mecka AI is building the data infrastructure layer for robotics and embodied AI.  
We design and operate global systems for data capture, data labeling, and hardware-enabled workflows used by leading AI labs and robotics companies to train and validate humanoid and embodied AI systems.  
We work closely with frontier robotics teams to bridge real-world data, simulation, learning-based systems, and deployed hardware.

**The role**

You'll take arms we buy off the shelf and make them safely, precisely controllable by an operator thousands of kilometers away. Many of these arms ship with no teleop stack and no teleop input device, so you'll choose and integrate the operator hardware, write the mapping from human motion to robot motion, and own everything that runs on the robot. You'll also be the person who makes sure every frame of data we record is correctly timestamped and synchronized.

**What you'll do**

* Integrate new commercial arms and grippers: vendor SDKs, drivers, calibration, and a common control interface.
* Evaluate and integrate operator input devices (leader arms, VR controllers, 6-DoF mice, haptics).
* Write and tune inverse kinematics and Cartesian/joint controllers for high DOF robotic arms for teleoperation and manipulation.
* Design for latency you can't remove: local safety limits, workspace and collision constraints, graceful handling of dropped or late packets, and safe stop when the link degrades.
* Prototype shared-autonomy features (assisted grasping, motion smoothing, task-level primitives) that make long-distance teleop faster and less tiring.
* Own sensor integration: cameras, depth, wrist cams, joint state, force/torque. Get time synchronization right across all of them.
* Work with a Teleop Platform Engineer on the end-to-end latency budget and on what we record, at what rate, in what format.
* Go to robot sites when needed to bring up hardware and debug in person.

**What we're looking for**

* 3+ years writing production level software that runs real robot hardware (arms strongly preferred), in industry or a serious research lab.
* Strong in C++ and/or Python; comfortable with Linux, real-time considerations, and debugging at the hardware boundary.
* Solid grasp of manipulator kinematics: forward/inverse kinematics, Jacobians, singularities, joint limits, and at least one way of doing Cartesian control well.

* Experience with impedance/admittance control, force feedback, or haptics.

**About us**

Over the last five years, Advocate Technologies has quietly been collecting and structuring a one-of-a-kind dataset with a single goal: bringing pricing transparency to risk. Through real-time market indices, gap analysis tools, and a proprietary rules engine, we have built a diversified data asset representing over $1.5B in insurance pricing exposure that does not exist anywhere else in the world.

We are now expanding a tactile, high-ownership Platform team responsible for the foundation everything else at Advocate runs on: our infrastructure, security, compliance, integrations, and internal tooling. The team operates with high standards under one mindset: identify the problem, solve it, and move on.

The bar is high, the feedback loop is tight, and your impact will be immediate. This is a rare opportunity to get in early and build something foundational in an industry overdue for change.

To learn more about Advocate, visit advocate.app.

**About the role.**

We’re hiring a NYC based Platform Engineer to own the foundation that Advocate’s product and people build on.

Advocate runs on a growing surface of cloud infrastructure, integrations, internal tooling, and the security and compliance controls a regulated insurance data business demands. In this role, you will (1) own our infrastructure, security, and compliance posture as code, versioned and shipped through automated pipelines, (2) build and maintain the integrations and internal tooling that keep the platform and the company running, and (3) build the automation, including AI agents, that lets a lean team move far faster than its size suggests.

You will work directly with the platform lead as a technical right hand on infrastructure, security, and automation decisions.

This is not a reactive role. It is a forward-looking ownership position responsible for making sure our foundation scales with our ambition, and that everyone else ships faster because of it.

**What you'll do**

* Own our cloud infrastructure end-to-end, defining it as code (Terraform or similar) and shipping every change through automated, reviewable CI/CD pipelines.
* Codify security and compliance controls, from access management and secrets to logging and audit evidence, so our posture is continuously enforced rather than manually checked.
* Run our vulnerability management program across code, dependencies, containers, cloud resources, and devices, from scanning and triage to remediation within defined SLAs, with routine fixes increasingly handled by automation.
* Build and maintain in-platform and out-of-platform integrations, from customer-facing data connections to the third-party systems the company runs on.
* Design and deploy AI agents and automation that take on repetitive infrastructure, security, and operations work, with the guardrails, evals, and human review needed to trust them in production.
* Own the IT asset lifecycle and tooling, including device provisioning, identity, SaaS access, and offboarding, automated wherever possible.
* Build internal tooling that shortens the path from idea to production for the whole engineering team.

**What success looks like**
---------------------------

* 30 days: You understand our infrastructure, our security and compliance posture, and our integration landscape, including what still lives outside of code. You're shipping meaningful changes through our pipelines.
* 90 days: You're independently owning areas end-to-end, bringing manually managed infrastructure and configuration into code, and you've shipped at least one agent or automation that removes recurring work from the team.
* 6 months: You've become the person who sees gaps before they slow us down, whether that's an unmanaged resource, an unpatched vulnerability, a control that should be enforced automatically, or a workflow that's ready to hand to an agent. Most routine platform changes now start as reviewable pull requests.

**What we're looking for**

* 3-6 years of experience in platform, infrastructure, DevOps, or SRE roles supporting production systems
* Strong hands-on experience with infrastructure as code (Terraform or equivalent) and a GitOps mindset: if it isn't in the repo, it doesn't exist
* Experience building CI/CD pipelines with automated testing, policy checks, and human review gates
* Solid grasp of a major cloud provider (AWS, GCP, or Azure), networking, identity and access management, and secrets management
* Advanced use of AI tools (Claude, Agents, etc), including building agent workflows, tool integrations (e.g. MCP), and evaluating their output
* Security-first mindset, hands-on vulnerability management experience (scanning, prioritization, remediation), and practical experience with compliance frameworks such as SOC 2 or ISO 27001
* Proficiency in at least one general-purpose language (Python, TypeScript, or Go) for automation and tooling
* Ability to work with high autonomy in a small team

**Nice to have**

* Exposure to insurance, financial services, or any regulated/data-dense industry
* Experience designing guardrails, evals, or policy-as-code (e.g. OPA) for automated or AI-driven changes
* Experience with compliance automation platforms (e.g. Vanta, Drata) and producing audit evidence
* Experience running IT and identity at a growing company: MDM, SSO/SCIM, and device and SaaS lifecycle
* Prior experience at an early-stage company or on a small team where you wore multiple hats
* Interest in agentic engineering and in rethinking how software teams build and operate products

* Equity / Stock Options - granted in addition to base salary
